sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 120. Applies Beguilement for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Revolutionary Element (increases max HP by 100%, increases all stats by 100%, increases Ability Power of critical hits by 30, and reduces Ability Cost consumption by 50%) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 60 seconds.
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +400
Only [Eminence in Shadow] Shadow can be used as Unlocking Potential material
